##### Nigerian AI Startup Khaime Raises USD 500 K Pre-Seed Funding Led By Launch Africa Ventures
Khaime, a Nigerian startup building an AI-powered commerce platform, has raised USD 500 K in pre-seed funding in a round led by Launch Africa Ventures, with participation from angel investors and early friends-and-family backers.

The funding will support Khaime’s development as it builds infrastructure for merchants to transact with both traditional online shoppers and autonomous shopping agents.

##### Nigerian E-Mobility Startup MAX Raises USD 29 M In Series B3 Funding With Nithio Investment
[MAX](https://www.maxdrive.ai/), a Nigerian electric mobility company headquartered in Lagos, has secured an undisclosed investment from US climate fintech Nithio, extending its Series B3 funding round to USD 29 M.

Founded in 2015 by Adetayo Bamiduro and Chinedu Azodoh, MAX provides electric vehicles to commercial transport operators through a subscription model that combines vehicle financing, battery-swapping infrastructure, digital payments and fleet management technology.

The latest investment follows a [USD 24 M funding round](https://weetracker.com/2026/01/16/max-raises-24m-electric-mobility-financing-africa/) in January 2026 and comes as MAX targets 250,000 drivers and more than USD 150 M in annual recurring revenue by 2027.
